name: Roivenue
description:
Roivenue is a marketing-attribution and data-integration platform. This connector lets you ask your own Roivenue data questions in plain language.
Ask how your channels and campaigns performed (revenue, cost, ROMI, conversions) under any attribution model, including Roivenue's AI Data Driven model. Explore customer journeys: typical path length, days to convert, which channels appear in the same converting paths, and the touchpoint-by-touchpoint story behind a single order. Check the health of your data sources and see when your data was last refreshed. Answers use the same defaults as your Roivenue app — your attribution model, currency and date window — so the numbers match what you see there, and the connector can hand you a deep link that opens the exact same view in Roivenue.
You sign in with your own Roivenue credentials (OAuth 2.1); the connector sees only the accounts and data your login already has access to, and every tool is read-only — the single exception records optional thumbs-up/down feedback. Customer-identifying fields are removed from journey and order data by design. Product-knowledge questions are answered from Roivenue's official documentation, with sources cited.
Requires a Roivenue subscription and login (app.roivenue.com).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Roivenue to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Roivenue to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dq.roivenue.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Roivenue MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roivenue lists 21 MCP tools, including account_markets, account_overview, connector_health, conversion_detail, data_freshness, describe_metrics, explorer_link, get_skill, list_accounts, list_dimension_values, my_settings, and path_histogram.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Roivenue?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Roivenue in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Roivenue requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Roivenue is developed by Roivenue s.r.o.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
